title: Feedback and recovery
guidance: Separate feedback paint from nearby recovery buttons. Rebalance information, warning and success tones in both themes. Recovery layout should follow one consistent structure. Keep messages concise and preserve meaningful uncertainty. Colors remain proposed until human judgment.
Revisit all banner roles and title/body/icon alignment with parent and page. Information, success, caution and failure use distinct restrained tones separate from recovery buttons.

decisions.title: Message paint and recovery action stay distinct
decisions.reason: Signals identify success/error/warning/info; neutral text carries the message. Recovery controls sit outside the painted live region with their own surface and spacing.

decisions.title: Quieter tones and rail
decisions.reason: Feedback-only info/success fills no longer inherit badge fills; warm warning and error fills are distinct from adjacent neutral actions. The rail is3px. All new colors await human judgment.

decisions.title: Enlarged copy uses the full measure
decisions.reason: At narrow enlarged widths the capped signal sits above the copy, preventing clipped words such as requirements or cancellation.

decisions.title: 1.8 message roles and copy alignment
decisions.reason: Information has a restrained indigo tone; success teal; caution amber; error coral. Colored icons plus text communicate status. One aligned copy column, subordinate body, restrained perimeter with no strong left rail; recovery actions are adjacent and blue rather than matching message fill.

parameters.name: Feedback composition
parameters.description: One copy column; message/controls separated structurally.

parameters.name: Proposed semantic paint
parameters.description: Values are read directly from theme.json. Text/icons also carry meaning; color alone is insufficient.

parameters.name: Message role boundaries
parameters.description: Shared perimeter is one hairline. The legacy bannerRail token remains for baseline compatibility; current recipe uses border.hairline.

status.human: feedback received; current revision awaits review
status.implementation: 1.9 local HTML implementation and specified checks passed; application adoption separate
status.visual: Independent normal composition across all94 named states in both themes/mobile/desktop, plus selected native child/parent/page and stress/live scopes. Individual captured-only pixels remain unvisited; see1.9 coverage.
status.color: Purple rejected. Replacement slate-blue/blue-teal palette awaiting human judgment
